 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Luciano Spalletti explains his Juventus choices against Fiorentina with an all-new trident attack, and sarcastically hits back at critics. 'You all say we need to win the Scudetto.'
 It kicks off at the Stadio Artemio Franchi at 19.45 GMT (20.45 CET).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement You can follow all the build-up and action as it happens from today's five Serie A games on the Liveblog. 
 The Bianconeri have a very poor recent record against their bitter rivals, not managing a victory since the 1-0 in April 2024, followed by two draws and as many defeats.
 Spalletti defends Juventus choices
 GENOA, ITALY – OCTOBER 28: Luciano Spalletti, head coach of Juventus, looks on prior to kick-off in the Serie A match between Genoa CFC and Juventus FC at Stadio Luigi Ferraris on October 28, 2026 in Genoa, Italy. (Photo by Simone Arveda/Getty Images)
 Weston McKennie and Zeki Celik are back in the squad, while Nick Woltemade came down with flu symptoms and is in the starting XI anyway as part of a new trident with Jeremie Boga and Randal Kolo Muani.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement That means sending Kerim Alajbegovic to the bench this evening .
 "We played two days ago, another three days before that, so we need to rest these players at some point," Spalletti told DAZN Italia. 
 "Boga scored a great goal off the bench, he went t sit back down, so every now and then we have to put our faith in these players."
 TURIN, ITALY – NOVEMBER 01: Kerim Alajbegovic of Juventus celebrates scoring his team's first goal with team mates during the Serie A match between Juventus and SSC Napoli at Allianz Stadium on November 01, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images)
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Juventus had been plunged into crisis by the 3-0 home defeat to Lazio and 2-2 Rennes draw, but recovered with back-to-back wins over Napoli and AZ Alkmaar.
 "It is a game where the volume will be turned up, in the crowd, on the field, it somehow becomes a bigger city when this game is one. So we must avoid getting manipulated or dragged into the frenetic nature of this fixture, we've got to keep our heads, and hopefully raise the quality level of our performance.
 "You all say we need to win the Scudetto, so we've got to play with the quality that this squad does possess," replied Spalletti with sarcasm to the Juventus critics.
 "Being frenetic robs you of the right choice, it stops you seeing things clearly, so this can be a turning point for us."
 ITALY – OCTOBER 25: Head coach of Juventus FC Luciano Spalletti looks on ahead the Serie A match between US Lecce and Juventus at Stadio Via del Mare on October 25, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Maurizio Lagana/Getty Images)
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Juventus are still missing Kenan Yildiz, Andrea Cambiaso, Nico Gonzalez, Manuel Locatelli, Khephren Thuram and Kamil Grabara, with Jeff Ekhator only just returning from a long spell out.
 "Ekhator is a physically strong centre-forward who can run into space, he has the strength to take a position against defenders and can hold up the ball. He is young, so he feels the pressure, as he probably did with these two injuries, he needs a little time, but we are happy to have him available as an alternative with different characteristics."
